headlines.title: Datadog Soars 5% as BofA Lifts Price Target to $335 Ahead of Q3 Earnings
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog shares rose 5% today after BofA raised its price target to $335 from $305 and kept its Buy rating. The rise follows Thursday’s 4% drop, which came after a report that Datadog had offered nearly $4 billion for cloud security startup Upwind.

headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Looks Undervalued Even After A 216% Run
headlines.summary: Datadog has delivered a powerful run over the past few years, helped by growing interest in observability tools and rising attention on AI workloads. With the share price now well above where it traded three years ago, the key question for investors is whether that move aligns with the cash the business can produce over time. Datadog has returned 215.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
